verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a SaaS tax API, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that TaxJar uses API keys passed in an Authorization header, with nothing on scopes, permissions, read-only keys or per-agent restrictions. A separate sandbox endpoint is an environment, not least-privilege credential scoping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
